rain_total_mm.notes: 10-year reference baseline. MERRA-2 and IMERG kept separate. 2026 IMERG has 47 trailing missing days (16 in July-Sept window) and is treated as incomplete without zero imputation.

dry_spell_max_days.notes: Evaluated strictly on the July 1 to September 30 dry-spell window. Longest dry spell averages 3-4 days in MERRA-2 and 5-6 days in IMERG.

dry_spells_ge7d.data_type: Count of dry spells lasting >= 7 consecutive days
dry_spells_ge7d.notes: Rare in MERRA-2 (0 occurrences across 10 years); IMERG identifies 0 to 2 occurrences per season.

ndvi_cover_nov_jun.notes: Landscape vegetation-cover context only. Pixel is ~6.25 ha and reflects area tree/brush cover; do not interpret as direct single-field crop stress or yield.

slope_pct.notes: Represents area-level slope context. Very gentle plain slope (<1%) with elevation 25-26 m; low water runoff erosion risk.

soil_texture.notes: Modelled soil prediction, not laboratory test. Silt fraction not extracted; partial textural indication only.

soc.notes: Modelled soil organic carbon prediction: 10.1 g/kg (0-5cm), 8.1 g/kg (5-15cm), 5.5 g/kg (15-30cm). Moderately low organic matter typical of West African upland soils.

ph.notes: Modelled soil prediction across 0-30cm depths. Moderately acidic topsoil (pH 5.2 - 5.4). Well-suited to groundnut, cowpea, and pearl millet; slightly acidic for sensitive maize varieties.

soil_moisture_regional.notes: Regional subsoil moisture snapshot (0-100cm). Nearest grid cell centroid is 6.168 km from field. Mid-month snapshots, not continuous field sensor probes.

disclaimer: Demonstration data grounded in NASA and SoilGrids pilot datasets. Recommendations are decision-support suggestions, not guaranteed yield outcomes. Farmers and local agricultural extension officers must review recommendations before field planting.
